title: Heat a tomato: E wins after a long microwave open/close loop
goal: heat some tomato and put it in diningtable.
shows: E finds the tomato in the fridge and puts it in the microwave with `move`, then opens and closes the microwave 6 times before it issues `heat tomato 3 with microwave 1`; 23 steps. C tries the stoveburner (invalid `place`/`turn on`) and fails.
why_interesting: A win that took 23 steps: the manual gave the right appliance and the agent eventually used the right command. Shows E is still sloppy even when it wins.
